extractions.quote: A day-hospital program of physical therapy was undertaken; it involved stretching of all posterior muscle planes, postural awareness exercises to decrease the lumbar lordosis, and analgesic pool therapy with water jets to induce muscle relaxation. A home exercise program conducted under the supervision of a physical therapist was started.

extractions.value: The patient lacked episodic spasms, which the authors note was the only classic symptom lacking; they suggest she may have been seen before the occurrence of spasms. The patient's pain was mechanical initially and worsened gradually. The first MRI showed increased lordosis with facet joint impingement; a second MRI was normal.
extractions.quote: Superimposed episodic spasms triggered by noise, emotions, and passive movement occur in some patients. This was the only classic symptom lacking in our patient. One possibility is that our patient was seen before the occurrence of spasms, which may appear late in the course of this very slowly progressive disease.
